diagnostics.message:
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app configures the GitHub App's webhook URL via local-exec, but it only references the API Gateway's endpoint string. The endpoint only serves requests once the `$default` stage (which auto-deploys the route and Lambda integration) has been created; on a first apply the provisioner can run before the stage/route/integration exist, registering a webhook URL that isn't live yet. It should be ordered after the API Gateway stage.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app runs a local-exec provisioner that registers the GitHub App webhook at var.webhook_endpoint, but its only dependency on the API Gateway is through the endpoint URL, which references aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook — not aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook. The $default stage is what deploys the route/integration so the endpoint actually serves requests (and accepts GitHub's validation ping); nothing in the graph orders the stage before the webhook registration. Add depends_on = [aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook] (via the runners module webhook output) so the stage is deployed before the GitHub App webhook is (re)configured.
